name: Rat.add.aux
type:
∀ (a b : Rat) {g ad bd : Nat},
  g = a.den.gcd b.den →
    ad = a.den / g →
      bd = b.den / g →
        have den := ad * b.den;
        have num := a.num * ↑bd + b.num * ↑ad;
        num.natAbs.gcd g = num.natAbs.gcd den

name: Rat.sub.aux
type:
∀ (a b : Rat) {g ad bd : Nat},
  g = a.den.gcd b.den →
    ad = a.den / g →
      bd = b.den / g →
        have den := ad * b.den;
        have num := a.num * ↑bd - b.num * ↑ad;
        num.natAbs.gcd g = num.natAbs.gcd den
